chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 427: The Vice Supervisor Unleashes the Office’s Power
chapter_meta_description: The Supervisory Heavenly Office gathers its forces for a crackdown on the Zuowandao. Before speaking a word, the Vice Supervisor neutralizes five infiltrators with chilling efficiency.
og_description: A moonlit glow, a crushing pressure, and five Zuowandao exposed by iron hooks. The Office is coming for them.
twitter_description: The Vice Supervisor demonstrates his power by collapsing five Zuowandao infiltrators before giving a single order.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-ranking official in the Supervisory Heavenly Office. There are five Vice Supervisors, and they report to the single Supervisor (司天监). Their authority is both bureaucratic and supernatural.

The highest-ranking official of the Supervisory Heavenly Office. The title is borrowed from the historical Imperial Directorate for Astronomy, but here it governs an agency that polices supernatural threats.

A small tool used by Office agents to peel back the facial skin of collapsed individuals, revealing the mahjong-patterned faces of disguised Zuowandao infiltrators. A visceral method of unmasking liars.
An official restriction on nighttime movement, imposed by the capital authorities during the buildup to the Office’s operation. Historically used by Chinese dynasties to maintain order during unrest.
